messages:
maya: Heads-up: our private endpoint policy rollout caused asymmetric routing for a small tenant cohort. No big outage but surfaced TLS handshakes failing. Need a compact canary + rollback checklist.

ravi: Agree. Proposal: 1) small canary (5% tenants, single region) 2) realtime alerts 3) manual hold button 4) automated safe-key rollback for non-network keys.

zoe: Important: include explicit steps to clear proxy connection pools and TLS session caches after rollback. Clients with resumed sessions kept failing.

maya: Canary config suggestions: short DNS TTL (30-60s), 5% sample, region pin to reduce blast radius. Bake quick health probes: TLS handshake counts + per-tenant auth errors.

trent: Rollback runbook (short):
- Detect: alert: endpoint.tls_errors > baseline * 2 for 2 mins
- Isolate: call api to pause rollout:
  curl -X POST "https://cp/api/endpoints/<id>/pause" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
- Revert: deploy last-good tag (git tag + terraform state restore)
- Reconcile: restart agent and push peer route table sync
- Invalidate caches: restart edge proxy or hit admin endpoint to drop TLS sessions
- Validate: run tenant curl tests + confirm zero TLS failures for 3 consecutive 1-min windows

zoe: Commands to verify peering/routes to include in runbook:
```
# from tenant host
ip route get <cp-ip>
# check peering policy
aws ec2 describe-transit-gateway-attachments --filters ...
```

ravi: Auto-rollback: only for keys flagged safe in config-metadata. For peering or route-policy keys require manual approve. infra-bot: policy link https://policy.internal/rollback-automation

maya: Also note post-incident artifacts to capture: config diff, agent logs, proxy logs, route table snapshots, pcap snippet. Add a short customer comms template.

trent: I'll add the one-page checklist and the safe-key whitelist to the repo. Let's run a tabletop next week.

infra-bot: Reminder: tag runbook owner on PR and keep oncall notified during rehearsals.
